pills.label: English guide

Included: Your entrance ticket and 45 minutes of live commentary inside Matthias Church, with skip-the-ticket-queue entry. That ticket alone is the main thing the budget walks leave out.
Guide: Led by a history-buff guide covering 1,100 years, from the Middle Ages to World War II. English only.

Weather: The walk is mostly outside, so bring an umbrella. In heavy rain the guide switches to more indoor locations.

Format: A night walk of the Castle District, away from the Pest crowds, in English, German or Spanish.

best_for.pick_html: for couples and groups who want Castle Hill after dark with a story, because €18 buys two hours of Dracula, Báthory and the Castle District lit up.
best_for.skip_html: if you want history straight: it leans on legends and lore, so take #1 or #2.

title.text: Budapest: Official Buda Castle Electric Hop-on/Hop-off Bus

pills.label: Valid 1 day
pills.pop_html: Valid 1 day. Pick your date and start time when you book.
The ride: A comfy open-air electric bus from Clark Ádám tér by the Chain Bridge up to the protected upper level of Castle Hill. No walking uphill.

pills.summary_html: 🔄 Hop off up to 3 times▾
pills.pop_html: Ticket: Valid for one round of the loop: you can use it 3 times to hop off and back on, and it expires when you return to Clark Ádám tér.

Stops: Covering Alexander Palace, the Royal Palace and National Gallery, the Labyrinth, Matthias Church, Fisherman's Bastion, Hospital in the Rock, Vienna Gate, the Mary Magdalene Tower and more, plus restaurants and bars.
Not included: No guided tour, no tips, and no extra rides beyond the one round.

pills.label: Starts at Clark Ádám tér
pills.pop_html: The Castle Bus starts at Clark Ádám tér and runs on the upper level of Castle Hill.

pills.label: Free cancellation
pills.pop_html: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before; reserve now, pay later.

best_for.pick_html: for anyone who cannot or does not want to walk up Castle Hill, because €18 gets you to the top on an electric bus with 5 stops.
best_for.skip_html: if you want stories and context: there is no guide, so any walk here explains more.
